title: Photo Duo 023 · USSBBW × 머슬 아워글래스 BBW · 둘 다 정면
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, the camera set close so the two of them fill the frame edge to edge, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subjects: TWO real adult women, both far beyond any real person in size, standing square to the camera with their feet planted far apart, their two bodies together so wide that they overflow the full width of the frame and are cut off by the left and right edges, pressed shoulder to shoulder with their sides squeezed against each other and the flesh bulging out where they touch.

Left woman: an East African woman in her late 50s, deep umber skin with a warm sheen, her face exactly the same tone as her body, long box braids gathered high. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, so much of it that it hangs far lower than it projects — sagging down toward her knees under its own weight rather than pushing forward, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. A gigantic bust above it, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders and an enormous rounded rear, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, very thick upper arms. Painted in polished malachite — vivid emerald and deep forest green in concentric swirling bands following every curve like contour lines on a map, a thin gold line between them.

Right woman: a Latina woman in her late 30s, warm golden-tan skin with olive undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, thick twin braids over her shoulders. Huge rounded shoulders and massive arms with the swell of the biceps showing through a soft layer of fat, a colossal bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly, the muscle of her core firm beneath it. Below it a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, so much of it that it hangs far lower than it projects — sagging down toward her knees under its own weight rather than pushing forward, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Enormous round hips, a gigantic powerful rear, colossal thighs with the sweep of the quads visible under a soft layer, no bodybuilder leanness. Painted in Japanese maki-e lacquer — glossy black lacquer with sprinkled gold powder shading into autumn grasses, chrysanthemums and full moons, bold gold bands following every curve.

Their outer arms are held away from their bodies with a visible gap of background at each side. On both: real photographic skin with visible pores, creases where the flesh folds and faint stretch marks, no illustration finish, no CG sheen. The paint is pigment on living skin, distorting over every bulge and cracking where it folds, covering everything below the jaw with no bare skin left; their faces unpainted, the pattern fading out at the neck. Neither arm crosses in front of her own body or the other woman's, both faces toward the camera. Every fold keeps its own rounded outline with a deep crease between them, never one shapeless mass; arms, hands and legs in correct proportion. Both wear extreme platform stiletto heels with soles as tall as their ankle bones.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation photograph, taller than it is wide.
